why_agent_cannot: nothing - the domain is dead or looks like a scam
what_human_must_do: Do not touch it: the domain check flagged it. Verify from the project's own X profile.
where_to_resume: python tools/triage.py https://kaisar.io   # then re-run bulk_apply
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Download the Provider App Open the Kaisar homepage and download the Provider App for MacOS, Windows or Linux.
2 Step 2 : Contribute your compute Run the app so your device shares spare computing power with the network, which is how Kaisar says contributors earn rewards when AI models run.
3 Step 3 : Connect a wallet on the Questverse page Open the Questverse page and connect your wallet.
4 Step 4 : Complete social tasks to earn badges Work through the social tasks on Questverse. Each completed task earns badges that count toward your standing.
5 Step 5 : Claim the daily check-in Open the Questverse home page and press Claim every day. Missing a day resets the day count.
6 Step 6 : Refer friends Share your referral link from your profile. Kaisar awards 200 points for each friend you refer.
